title: Circa Survivor
description: Forty-nine survivors; an $18.7 million prize, and now, the hedge, with Weeks 14 through 16 delivering the final stretch before the Christmas slate, the psychology of the contest reaches a fever pitch; Who takes the money? Who rolls the dice? Going deep inside the minds of the contestants still standing, exploring the impossible decisions that come with life-changing sums of money on the line.

title: Circa Survivor
description: Weeks 17 through 20 deliver twists, controversy and moments that will be talked about for years; picks leaked online; last-minute hedge decisions with millions at stake; the final few survivors grinding through the most pressure-filled weeks.

title: Circa Survivor
description: The contestants get the glory. But who builds the machine? Go behind the cameras and inside the control room for an unprecedented look at what it actually takes to produce Circa Survivor, from the production war room to real-time crew reactions.
